name: MonarchCombobox
title: Combobox
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with an editable androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField and ExposedDropdownMenu (menu), or a read-only anchor that opens androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with MonarchSearchBar and androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn (sheet)
summary: A labelled field that chooses one option from a searchable list: a filtered menu under an editable field for short lists, or a bottom sheet with a search field for long ones.
whenToUse: For one choice among many options the person finds by typing: an assignee, a country, a project, a label that may need creating.
whenNotToUse: For a short, fixed list without search use MonarchSelect. For several values use MonarchTagInput or MonarchCheckboxGroup. For a free search that shows results rather than choosing a value use MonarchSearchBar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCombobox(label: String, options: List<MonarchComboboxOption>, selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, presentation: MonarchComboboxPresentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Automatic, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, sortByMatch: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, clearOptionLabel: String? = null, limit: Int? = null, query: String? = null, onQueryChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, filter: ((MonarchComboboxOption, String) -> Boolean)? = null, onCreate: ((String) -> MonarchComboboxOption?)? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())
class MonarchComboboxOption(id: String, label: String, description: String? = null, hint: String? = null, group: String? = null, keywords: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true)
enum class MonarchComboboxPresentation { Automatic, Menu, Sheet }

class MonarchComboboxLabels(search: String? = null, loading: String? = null, empty: String? = null, create: ((text: String) -> String)? = null, more: ((shown: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, cancel: String? = null, clear: String? = null)

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the field and is the title of the sheet.

options.name: options
options.description: The options in order: id, label, description, hint, group, keywords and enabled.

options.name: selected
options.description: The id of the chosen option, or null.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the id of the chosen option, or null when the selection is cleared.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the field.

options.name: presentation
options.description: Menu, Sheet, or Automatic: a menu for up to eight options the app does not search, a sheet otherwise.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the list can be opened.

options.name: loading
options.description: Options are being fetched: "Loading…" while nothing matches, and the sheet's search field shows its pending state.

options.name: sortByMatch
options.description: While searching, lists labels that start with the text first, then labels with a word that does, then the rest, keeping the order within each.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the empty field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: helperText
options.description: Guidance below the field.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message; replaces the helper text and is set as the field's error.

options.name: clearOptionLabel
options.description: Adds a first row that clears the selection, such as "Unassigned". Hidden while searching.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows at most this many matches, with "Showing 50 of 120. Type to narrow the list.".

options.name: query
options.description: The search text, for apps that search a server: pass it with onQueryChange and a filter that keeps every option, and update options and loading from it.

options.name: onQueryChange
options.description: Called with the search text on every keystroke and with "" when the list closes. Setting it makes the automatic presentation a sheet.

options.name: filter
options.description: Decides whether an option matches the trimmed search text. By default the label, hint and keywords are searched, ignoring case and accents.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Offers "Create “text”" when no label equals the typed text. Return the new option to choose it, or null to only close the list.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of a clear button at the end of the field, shown while something is chosen. Monarch bundles no icons; without it there is no clear button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings.

options.name: loadError
options.description: The options could not be loaded: the list shows the message (empty uses the built-in one).

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Try again after loadError; the list stays open.

options.name: MonarchComboboxOption.leading
options.description: Decorative content before the label, such as a flag.

options.name: MonarchComboboxOption.labelLocale
options.description: The language of the label, so TalkBack reads an endonym correctly.

states.name: closed
states.description: The field shows the chosen label, or the placeholder (or the floating label) while nothing is chosen.

states.name: menu open
states.description: The field holds the search text, with the chosen label as its placeholder, and the Material 3 menu lists the matches under their group headings.

states.name: sheet open
states.description: A modal bottom sheet titled with the label holds a search field, the list of selectable rows and Cancel.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The chosen row has a filled radio mark in the accent strong color and is selected for TalkBack.

states.name: no matches
states.description: "No matches" in the list, or the Create row when onCreate is given.

states.name: loading
states.description: "Loading…" in the list while nothing matches; the sheet's search field shows the pending indicator.

states.name: cut short
states.description: A note under the list with the number shown and the number of matches.

states.name: error
states.description: The danger outline and label, and the message under the field.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled colors; the list does not open. Disabled options are listed in the disabled color and cannot be chosen.

appearance: The field uses MonarchTextField's colors: a surface fill with the input border, the focus ring when focused, the danger strong color in error. The menu and the sheet are on the surface color; descriptions, hints, headings and messages are muted text; the chosen row's radio mark is the accent strong color and others the input border. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named two Material 3 forms and both are offered: the exposed dropdown with an editable field for short lists, and a searchable list in a ModalBottomSheet for long ones, chosen automatically or with presentation. iOS always uses a sheet with .searchable. The web shows a popover under a typing field with keyboard navigation; on Android the menu keeps Material's focus handling and hardware-keyboard navigation of the menu. Only single selection is offered (the web's multiple mode is MonarchTagInput). The web's onSearch with built-in debounce and abort, minSearchLength and the error and retry row are replaced by query and onQueryChange: the app runs the search, for example in a LaunchedEffect keyed on the text, which Compose cancels when the text changes. The web's media and renderOption have no equivalent; the label names each option. The iOS isRequired and isClearable options are not offered: a clear button needs an icon, so it is shown only when clearIcon is given, and clearOptionLabel adds a clear row instead. The sheet's title is the label, as on iOS.
accessibility: The field is the Material 3 exposed dropdown anchor: TalkBack reads the label, the chosen value and the expand state, and double tap opens the list; in the menu presentation the field is editable and typing filters the list.

Every option row is read with its label, description and hint, and the chosen row is selected and has a filled radio mark, so the choice does not rely on color. In the sheet each row is a radio button with a 48dp height.
Disabled options are disabled; group headings are headings.
Messages in the list (Loading, No matches, the cut-short note) are polite live regions.
The clear button is a separate button named "Clear" with a 48dp touch target.
The error is the field's error semantics and is shown as text with a danger outline.
edgeCases: A selected id that is not among the options shows an empty field.
Typing in the menu replaces the field's text; closing the menu restores the chosen label and clears the search text.
With query and onQueryChange the combobox does not filter by itself only if filter keeps every option; otherwise the default filter still applies to the options the app passes.
Create is not offered when a label equals the typed text, ignoring case and accents.
Options with the same group that are not next to each other get two headings.
A limit of 0 shows no options, only the note.

examples.title: Searchable picker
examples.template:
MonarchCombobox(
    label = {{label}},
    options = listOf(
        MonarchComboboxOption({{options.0.value}}, {{options.0.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption({{options.1.value}}, {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption({{options.2.value}}, {{options.2.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption({{options.3.value}}, {{options.3.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption({{options.4.value}}, {{options.4.label}}, description = {{options.4.description}}),
    ),
    selected = timeZone,
    onSelectedChange = { timeZone = it },
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchCombobox(
    label = "Time zone",
    options = listOf(
        MonarchComboboxOption("asia-kolkata", "Asia/Kolkata"),
        MonarchComboboxOption("europe-london", "Europe/London"),
        MonarchComboboxOption("america-new-york", "America/New_York"),
        MonarchComboboxOption("asia-tokyo", "Asia/Tokyo"),
        MonarchComboboxOption("utc", "UTC", description = "Coordinated Universal Time"),
    ),
    selected = timeZone,
    onSelectedChange = { timeZone = it },
    placeholder = "Search",
)

examples.title: A long list in a sheet
examples.code:
MonarchCombobox(
    label = "Country",
    options = countries,
    selected = country,
    onSelectedChange = { country = it },
    sortByMatch = true,
    limit = 50,
)

examples.title: Creating a value
examples.setup:
val tags = remember { mutableStateListOf(MonarchComboboxOption("bug", "Bug")) }
var tag by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
examples.code:
MonarchCombobox(
    label = "Label",
    options = tags,
    selected = tag,
    onSelectedChange = { tag = it },
    onCreate = { text -> MonarchComboboxOption(text.lowercase(), text).also { tags += it } },
)
